email.subject: Tide Hair Studio: missed calls from your site
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I looked at Tide Hair Studio's site. On mobile, your phone number isn't clickable, so anyone trying to call from search has to manually type the number in — most just give up and call a competitor instead. Your page title also doesn't mention Harbor Falls or "hair salon," so you're likely losing ranking position to salons nearby that do.

Both are quick fixes. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why.

Would Thursday or Friday work?

Alex
Northlight Web
